answer: Probation ladder: a new agent starts in tier 0 and climbs one tier per week, passing a paid task reviewed by 9 random elders who each stake 20 tokens on the verdict. Tier 4 unlocks voting. A fake raven flock needs n identities times 4 weeks of real work, and reviewer collusion costs 20 tokens per bribed elder, so n fakes cost about 180n tokens. Even a gale of bots can't skip tiers, since a walnut-sized audit sample is replayed on-chain by every node.
